Binance is the world's largest crypto exchange by daily trading volumes. News of the hacking attack, which is thought to be the biggest-ever crypto heist, caused the prices of most major cryptocurrencies to fall sharply on Friday. The company has offered reassurances that it will cover the losses from the attack, saying it has used company funds to buy tokens to replenish 90 percent of what was stolen. Binance suspended user withdrawals after the attack but said they would be resumed in phases, the first of which began on Sunday. "First batch network now opened in phase one of withdrawals," the exchange posted on X. The US law enforcement agency accused North Korea of being behind the hack in a statement on Saturday, confirming earlier suspicions from private investigators and analysts that a Pyongyang-affiliated group called TraderTraitor was responsible. TraderTraitor is the same group blamed for a $1.5 billion theft from the Bybit platform in February last year.
